name: Hasdai Crescas
shortBio: Catalan-Aragonese Jewish philosopher and communal leader; author of The Light of the Lord, presenting a radical critique of Aristotelian physics and anticipating classical modern mechanics.
centralQuestion: Why must Aristotelian physical dogmas on the impossibility of the void, infinite space, and plurality of worlds be rejected to affirm divine omnipotence and unconditional love?

keyWorks.title: The Light of the Lord (Or Hashem)
keyWorks.description: Radical anti-Aristotelian treatise establishing the infinite void, absolute space, causal determinism, and divine joy.
